reason: It might look nice on my desk, but my tap water is fine and I've already got a Brita, so I'd be paying almost $70 up front plus a filter subscription to fix a problem I don't have. On $29k that's a lot for a bottle when I could just grab a cute one without a filter for less.
objection: I don't need filtered water on the go, and I don't want another subscription eating at my budget every few months.
would_change_my_mind: If the bottle looked genuinely great and I could get it alone for around $30 shipped with no subscription push.
